### 🏷 Type of Change
<!-- Please mark the applicable boxes with an 'x'. -->
- [ ] `feat`: A new design system or showcase component
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix or visual alignment correction
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates or token refinements (`DESIGN.md`, `README.md`)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without visual or functional changes
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization (e.g., asset loading, CSS efficiency)
- [ ] `test`: Added or updated verification checks / test suites
- [ ] `build`: Changes that affect the build system or external tooling
- [ ] `ci`: Changes to CI configuration files and workflows
- [ ] `chore`: Routine maintenance, repo hygiene, or meta updates
- [ ] `revert`: Reverting a previous commit or PR

### 📋 Quality Checklist
<!-- Review and mark the checkboxes once fulfilled. -->
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (clean HTML5, CSS custom properties, 2-space indent).
- [ ] I have performed a comprehensive self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have verified responsive layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
- [ ] I have verified color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards.
- [ ] Any added `DESIGN.md` contains complete color palettes, typography hierarchies, and component tokens.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or relevant system docs) accordingly.
- [ ] No extraneous dependencies or heavy third-party bundles have been introduced.
- [ ] My changes generate no new console warnings or JavaScript errors.
- [ ] Breaking changes (if any) are clearly documented and justified.
